ROUX X BALLER EVENTS Presents The Hottest Halloween Night In Chicago on Fri Oct 30 @ Hubbard INN

About this Event

ROUX X BALLER EVENTS PRESENT

🎃 BOLLYWEEN CHICAGO 🩸
CHICAGO’S HOTTEST BOLLYWOOD HALLOWEEN TAKEOVERChicago, Halloween is about to get dangerous. 🕸️🔥
This October, ROUX X BALLER EVENTS take over Hubbard Inn for BOLLYWEEN — a high-energy Halloween night built around Bollywood, Punjabi hits, packed dance floors, wild costumes, and late-night Chicago energy.
Leading the night:
DJ MISS BHALLA & DJ ROZE 🎧
Expect Bollywood anthems, Desi club bangers, Punjabi favorites, throwbacks, and nonstop party energy from doors open until close.
Come dressed to turn heads. This is BOLLYWEEN.

EVENT DETAILSDATE: Friday, October 30, 2026
TIME: Doors Open 10 PM
VENUE: Hubbard Inn — Chicago
21+
Early arrival is strongly recommended.

COSTUME & DRESS CODEHalloween costumes are highly encouraged. 🎭
Come in your best costume or elevated nightlife attire.
Management reserves the right to deny entry based on dress code, intoxication, capacity, or inappropriate conduct.

ID REQUIREMENTSA valid government-issued photo ID, driver’s license, or passport is required for entry.
Photos, photocopies, screenshots, or expired identification may be refused.

ENTRY POLICYAdmission is subject to venue capacity and management discretion.
Purchasing a ticket does not permit guests to bypass venue rules, security procedures, dress code requirements, or ID requirements.
Guests who arrive excessively intoxicated or behave inappropriately may be denied entry or removed without refund.

BEHAVIOR POLICYROUX and Hubbard Inn maintain a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, unwanted touching, fighting, threatening behavior, or conduct that interferes with another guest’s experience.
Management and security reserve the right to remove any guest when necessary to maintain a safe environment.
Guests are responsible for the behavior of everyone in their party.
